context.transcript:
Hello, this message is for Mr. Kwan at Quality Furniture Company.
This is Jessica Robertson from Salazar Supply.
I'm calling about the metal drawer handles that you ordered last week.
I know you were expecting the handles this morning and they're on the delivery truck now.
But I just spoke to the driver and he has several more stops to make on his route.
Sorry for the inconvenience.
Oh, and by the way, thank you for paying electronically.
We had a little difficulty with our payment processing, but yours was received on time.
context.transcript_translation:
您好，这条信息是给 Quality Furniture Company 的 Kwan 先生的。
我是 Salazar Supply 的 Jessica Robertson。
我打电话来是关于您上周订购的金属抽屉把手的。
我知道您预计今天早上能收到这些把手，它们现在已经在送货卡车上了。
但我刚和司机谈过，他还有几个站点需要拜访。
很抱歉给您带来不便。
哦，顺便说一下，谢谢您的电子支付。
我们的付款处理遇到了一点困难，但您的款项是准时收到的。
